lines.text: The Prince of Cumberland: which honour must

lines.speaker: DUNCAN
lines.text: Not unaccompanied invest him only,

lines.speaker: DUNCAN
lines.text: But signs of nobleness, like stars, shall shine

lines.speaker: DUNCAN
lines.text: On all deservers.—From hence to Inverness,

lines.speaker: DUNCAN
lines.text: And bind us further to you.

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: The rest is labour, which is not us’d for you:

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: I’ll be myself the harbinger, and make joyful

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: The hearing of my wife with your approach;

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: So, humbly take my leave.

lines.speaker: DUNCAN
lines.text: My worthy Cawdor!
[_Aside._]

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: The Prince of Cumberland!—That is a step

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: On which I must fall down, or else o’erleap,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: For in my way it lies. Stars, hide your fires!

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Let not light see my black and deep desires.

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: The eye wink at the hand, yet let that be,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Which the eye fears, when it is done, to see.
[_Exit._]

lines.speaker: DUNCAN
lines.text: True, worthy Banquo! He is full so valiant;

lines.speaker: DUNCAN
lines.text: And in his commendations I am fed.

lines.speaker: DUNCAN
lines.text: It is a banquet to me. Let’s after him,

lines.speaker: DUNCAN
lines.text: Whose care is gone before to bid us welcome:

lines.speaker: DUNCAN
lines.text: It is a peerless kinsman.
[_Flourish. Exeunt._]

scenes.setting: Inverness. A Room in Macbeth’s Castle.

lines.text: Enter Lady Macbeth, reading a letter.

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: “They met me in the day of success; and I have learned by the

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: perfect’st report they have more in them than mortal knowledge. When I

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: burned in desire to question them further, they made themselves air,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: into which they vanished. Whiles I stood rapt in the wonder of it, came

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: missives from the King, who all-hailed me, ‘Thane of Cawdor’; by which

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: title, before, these Weird Sisters saluted me, and referred me to the

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: coming on of time, with ‘Hail, king that shalt be!’ This have I thought

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: good to deliver thee (my dearest partner of greatness) that thou

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: might’st not lose the dues of rejoicing, by being ignorant of what

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: greatness is promis’d thee. Lay it to thy heart, and farewell.”

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Glamis thou art, and Cawdor; and shalt be

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: What thou art promis’d. Yet do I fear thy nature;

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: It is too full o’ th’ milk of human kindness

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: To catch the nearest way. Thou wouldst be great;

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Art not without ambition, but without

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: The illness should attend it. What thou wouldst highly,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: That wouldst thou holily; wouldst not play false,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: And yet wouldst wrongly win. Thou’dst have, great Glamis,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: That which cries, “Thus thou must do,” if thou have it;

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: And that which rather thou dost fear to do,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Than wishest should be undone. Hie thee hither,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: That I may pour my spirits in thine ear,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: And chastise with the valour of my tongue

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: All that impedes thee from the golden round,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Which fate and metaphysical aid doth seem

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: To have thee crown’d withal.
Enter a Messenger.

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: What is your tidings?

lines.speaker: MESSENGER
lines.text: The King comes here tonight.

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Thou’rt mad to say it.

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Is not thy master with him? who, were’t so,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Would have inform’d for preparation.

lines.speaker: MESSENGER
lines.text: So please you, it is true. Our thane is coming.

lines.speaker: MESSENGER
lines.text: One of my fellows had the speed of him,

lines.speaker: MESSENGER
lines.text: Who, almost dead for breath, had scarcely more

lines.speaker: MESSENGER
lines.text: Than would make up his message.

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Give him tending.

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: He brings great news.
[_Exit Messenger._]

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: The raven himself is hoarse

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: That croaks the fatal entrance of Duncan

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Under my battlements. Come, you spirits

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: That tend on mortal thoughts, unsex me here,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: And fill me, from the crown to the toe, top-full

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Of direst cruelty! make thick my blood,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Stop up th’ access and passage to remorse,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: That no compunctious visitings of nature

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Shake my fell purpose, nor keep peace between

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Th’ effect and it! Come to my woman’s breasts,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: And take my milk for gall, your murd’ring ministers,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Wherever in your sightless substances

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: You wait on nature’s mischief! Come, thick night,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: And pall thee in the dunnest smoke of hell

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: That my keen knife see not the wound it makes,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Nor heaven peep through the blanket of the dark

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: To cry, “Hold, hold!”
Enter Macbeth.

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Great Glamis, worthy Cawdor!

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Greater than both, by the all-hail hereafter!

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Thy letters have transported me beyond

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: This ignorant present, and I feel now

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: The future in the instant.

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: My dearest love,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Duncan comes here tonight.

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: And when goes hence?

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Tomorrow, as he purposes.

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: O, never

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Shall sun that morrow see!

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Your face, my thane, is as a book where men

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: May read strange matters. To beguile the time,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Look like the time; bear welcome in your eye,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Your hand, your tongue: look like the innocent flower,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: But be the serpent under’t. He that’s coming

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Must be provided for; and you shall put

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: This night’s great business into my dispatch;

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Which shall to all our nights and days to come

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Give solely sovereign sway and masterdom.

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: We will speak further.

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Only look up clear;

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: To alter favour ever is to fear.

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Leave all the rest to me.
[_Exeunt._]

scenes.setting: The same. Before the Castle.

lines.text: Hautboys. Servants of Macbeth attending.
Enter Duncan, Malcolm, Donalbain, Banquo, Lennox, Macduff, Ross, Angus and Attendants.

lines.speaker: DUNCAN
lines.text: This castle hath a pleasant seat. The air

lines.speaker: DUNCAN
lines.text: Nimbly and sweetly recommends itself

lines.speaker: DUNCAN
lines.text: Unto our gentle senses.

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: This guest of summer,

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: The temple-haunting martlet, does approve,

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: By his loved mansionry, that the heaven’s breath

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: Smells wooingly here: no jutty, frieze,

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: Buttress, nor coign of vantage, but this bird

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: hath made his pendant bed and procreant cradle.

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: Where they most breed and haunt, I have observ’d

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: The air is delicate.
Enter Lady Macbeth.

lines.speaker: DUNCAN
lines.text: See, see, our honour’d hostess!—

lines.speaker: DUNCAN
lines.text: The love that follows us sometime is our trouble,

lines.speaker: DUNCAN
lines.text: Which still we thank as love. Herein I teach you

lines.speaker: DUNCAN
lines.text: How you shall bid God ’ild us for your pains,

lines.speaker: DUNCAN
lines.text: And thank us for your trouble.

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: All our service,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: In every point twice done, and then done double,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Were poor and single business to contend

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Against those honours deep and broad wherewith

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Your Majesty loads our house: for those of old,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: And the late dignities heap’d up to them,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: We rest your hermits.

lines.speaker: DUNCAN
lines.text: Where’s the Thane of Cawdor?

lines.speaker: DUNCAN
lines.text: We cours’d him at the heels, and had a purpose

lines.speaker: DUNCAN
lines.text: To be his purveyor: but he rides well;

lines.speaker: DUNCAN
lines.text: And his great love, sharp as his spur, hath holp him

lines.speaker: DUNCAN
lines.text: To his home before us. Fair and noble hostess,

lines.speaker: DUNCAN
lines.text: We are your guest tonight.

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Your servants ever

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Have theirs, themselves, and what is theirs, in compt,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: To make their audit at your Highness’ pleasure,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Still to return your own.

lines.speaker: DUNCAN
lines.text: Give me your hand;

lines.speaker: DUNCAN
lines.text: Conduct me to mine host: we love him highly,

lines.speaker: DUNCAN
lines.text: And shall continue our graces towards him.

lines.speaker: DUNCAN
lines.text: By your leave, hostess.
[_Exeunt._]

scenes.setting: The same. A Lobby in the Castle.

lines.text: Hautboys and torches. Enter, and pass over, a Sewer and divers Servants with dishes and service. Then enter Macbeth.

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: If it were done when ’tis done, then ’twere well

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: It were done quickly. If th’ assassination

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Could trammel up the consequence, and catch

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: With his surcease success; that but this blow

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Might be the be-all and the end-all—here,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: But here, upon this bank and shoal of time,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: We’d jump the life to come. But in these cases

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: We still have judgement here; that we but teach

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Bloody instructions, which being taught, return

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: To plague th’ inventor. This even-handed justice

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Commends th’ ingredience of our poison’d chalice

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: To our own lips. He’s here in double trust:

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: First, as I am his kinsman and his subject,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Strong both against the deed; then, as his host,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Who should against his murderer shut the door,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Not bear the knife myself. Besides, this Duncan

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Hath borne his faculties so meek, hath been

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: So clear in his great office, that his virtues

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Will plead like angels, trumpet-tongued, against

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: The deep damnation of his taking-off;

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: And pity, like a naked new-born babe,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Striding the blast, or heaven’s cherubin, hors’d

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Upon the sightless couriers of the air,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Shall blow the horrid deed in every eye,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: That tears shall drown the wind.—I have no spur

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: To prick the sides of my intent, but only

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Vaulting ambition, which o’erleaps itself

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: And falls on th’ other—
Enter Lady Macbeth.

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: How now! what news?

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: He has almost supp’d. Why have you left the chamber?

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Hath he ask’d for me?

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Know you not he has?

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: We will proceed no further in this business:

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: He hath honour’d me of late; and I have bought

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Golden opinions from all sorts of people,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Which would be worn now in their newest gloss,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Not cast aside so soon.

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Was the hope drunk

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Wherein you dress’d yourself? Hath it slept since?

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: And wakes it now, to look so green and pale

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: At what it did so freely? From this time

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Such I account thy love. Art thou afeard

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: To be the same in thine own act and valour

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: As thou art in desire? Wouldst thou have that

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Which thou esteem’st the ornament of life,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: And live a coward in thine own esteem,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Letting “I dare not” wait upon “I would,”

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Like the poor cat i’ th’ adage?

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Pr’ythee, peace!

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: I dare do all that may become a man;

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Who dares do more is none.

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: What beast was’t, then,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: That made you break this enterprise to me?

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: When you durst do it, then you were a man;

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: And, to be more than what you were, you would

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Be so much more the man. Nor time nor place

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Did then adhere, and yet you would make both:

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: They have made themselves, and that their fitness now

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Does unmake you. I have given suck, and know

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: How tender ’tis to love the babe that milks me:

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: I would, while it was smiling in my face,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Have pluck’d my nipple from his boneless gums

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: And dash’d the brains out, had I so sworn as you

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Have done to this.

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: If we should fail?

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: We fail?

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: But screw your courage to the sticking-place,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: And we’ll not fail. When Duncan is asleep

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: (Whereto the rather shall his day’s hard journey

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Soundly invite him), his two chamberlains

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Will I with wine and wassail so convince

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: That memory, the warder of the brain,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Shall be a fume, and the receipt of reason

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: A limbeck only: when in swinish sleep

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Their drenched natures lie as in a death,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: What cannot you and I perform upon

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Th’ unguarded Duncan? what not put upon

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: His spongy officers; who shall bear the guilt

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Of our great quell?

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Bring forth men-children only;

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: For thy undaunted mettle should compose

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Nothing but males. Will it not be receiv’d,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: When we have mark’d with blood those sleepy two

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Of his own chamber, and us’d their very daggers,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: That they have done’t?

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Who dares receive it other,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: As we shall make our griefs and clamour roar

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Upon his death?

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: I am settled, and bend up

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Each corporal agent to this terrible feat.

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Away, and mock the time with fairest show:

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: False face must hide what the false heart doth know.
[_Exeunt._]

scenes.setting: Inverness. Court within the Castle.

lines.text: Enter Banquo and Fleance with a torch before him.

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: How goes the night, boy?

lines.speaker: FLEANCE
lines.text: The moon is down; I have not heard the clock.

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: And she goes down at twelve.

lines.speaker: FLEANCE
lines.text: I take’t, ’tis later, sir.

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: Hold, take my sword.—There’s husbandry in heaven;

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: Their candles are all out. Take thee that too.

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: A heavy summons lies like lead upon me,

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: And yet I would not sleep. Merciful powers,

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: Restrain in me the cursed thoughts that nature

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: Gives way to in repose!
Enter Macbeth and a Servant with a torch.

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: Give me my sword.—Who’s there?

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: A friend.

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: What, sir, not yet at rest? The King’s abed:

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: He hath been in unusual pleasure and

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: Sent forth great largess to your offices.

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: This diamond he greets your wife withal,

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: By the name of most kind hostess, and shut up

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: In measureless content.

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Being unprepar’d,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Our will became the servant to defect,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Which else should free have wrought.

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: All’s well.

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: I dreamt last night of the three Weird Sisters:

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: To you they have show’d some truth.

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: I think not of them:

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Yet, when we can entreat an hour to serve,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: We would spend it in some words upon that business,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: If you would grant the time.

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: At your kind’st leisure.

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: If you shall cleave to my consent, when ’tis,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: It shall make honour for you.

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: So I lose none

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: In seeking to augment it, but still keep

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: My bosom franchis’d, and allegiance clear,

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: I shall be counsell’d.

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Good repose the while!

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: Thanks, sir: the like to you.
[_Exeunt Banquo and Fleance._]

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Go bid thy mistress, when my drink is ready,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: She strike upon the bell. Get thee to bed.
[_Exit Servant._]

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Is this a dagger which I see before me,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: The handle toward my hand? Come, let me clutch thee:—

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: I have thee not, and yet I see thee still.

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Art thou not, fatal vision, sensible

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: To feeling as to sight? or art thou but

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: A dagger of the mind, a false creation,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Proceeding from the heat-oppressed brain?

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: I see thee yet, in form as palpable

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: As this which now I draw.

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Thou marshall’st me the way that I was going;

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: And such an instrument I was to use.

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Mine eyes are made the fools o’ the other senses,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Or else worth all the rest: I see thee still;

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: And on thy blade and dudgeon, gouts of blood,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Which was not so before.—There’s no such thing.

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: It is the bloody business which informs

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Thus to mine eyes.—Now o’er the one half-world

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Nature seems dead, and wicked dreams abuse

lines.text: Pale Hecate’s off’rings; and wither’d murder,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Alarum’d by his sentinel, the wolf,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Whose howl’s his watch, thus with his stealthy pace,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: With Tarquin’s ravishing strides, towards his design

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Moves like a ghost.—Thou sure and firm-set earth,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Hear not my steps, which way they walk, for fear

lines.text: Thy very stones prate of my whereabout,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: And take the present horror from the time,

lines.speaker: MACBETH

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Words to the heat of deeds too cold breath gives.
[_A bell rings._]

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: I go, and it is done. The bell invites me.

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Hear it not, Duncan, for it is a knell

lines.speaker: MACBETH

[_Exit._]

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: He could not miss ’em.—Had he not resembled

lines.text: Balm of hurt minds, great nature’s second course,

lines.text: And wash this filthy witness from your hand.—

lines.text: Infirm of purpose!

lines.text: Are but as pictures. ’Tis the eye of childhood

lines.text: That fears a painted devil. If he do bleed,

lines.text: Whence is that knocking?

lines.text: Clean from my hand? No, this my hand will rather

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH

lines.text: To wear a heart so white. [_Knocking within._] I hear knocking

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: A little water clears us of this deed:

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH

lines.text: Hath left you unattended.—[_Knocking within._] Hark, more knocking.

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Get on your nightgown, lest occasion call us

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: And show us to be watchers. Be not lost

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: So poorly in your thoughts.

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: To know my deed, ’twere best not know myself.

lines.speaker: MACBETH

lines.text: here you’ll sweat for’t. [_Knocking._] Knock, knock! Who’s there, i’

lines.speaker: PORTER
lines.text: th’ other devil’s name? Faith, here’s an equivocator, that could swear

lines.speaker: PORTER
lines.text: in both the scales against either scale, who committed treason enough

lines.speaker: PORTER
lines.text: for God’s sake, yet could not equivocate to heaven: O, come in,

lines.speaker: PORTER
lines.text: equivocator. [_Knocking._] Knock, knock, knock! Who’s there? Faith,

lines.speaker: PORTER

lines.speaker: PORTER
lines.text: hose: come in, tailor; here you may roast your goose.

lines.text: Knock, knock. Never at quiet! What are you?—But this place is too cold

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: Was it so late, friend, ere you went to bed,

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: That you do lie so late?

lines.speaker: PORTER
lines.text: Faith, sir, we were carousing till the second cock; and drink, sir, is

lines.speaker: PORTER
lines.text: a great provoker of three things.

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: What three things does drink especially provoke?

lines.speaker: PORTER
lines.text: Marry, sir, nose-painting, sleep, and urine. Lechery, sir, it provokes

lines.speaker: PORTER
lines.text: and unprovokes; it provokes the desire, but it takes away the

lines.speaker: PORTER
lines.text: performance. Therefore much drink may be said to be an equivocator with

lines.speaker: PORTER
lines.text: lechery: it makes him, and it mars him; it sets him on, and it takes

lines.speaker: PORTER
lines.text: him off; it persuades him, and disheartens him; makes him stand to, and

lines.speaker: PORTER
lines.text: not stand to; in conclusion, equivocates him in a sleep, and giving him

lines.speaker: PORTER
lines.text: the lie, leaves him.

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: I believe drink gave thee the lie last night.

lines.speaker: PORTER
lines.text: That it did, sir, i’ the very throat on me; but I requited him for his

lines.speaker: PORTER
lines.text: lie; and (I think) being too strong for him, though he took up my legs

lines.speaker: PORTER
lines.text: sometime, yet I made a shift to cast him.

lines.text: Good morrow, noble sir!

lines.text: Good morrow, both!

lines.text: Is the King stirring, worthy thane?

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Not yet.

lines.text: He did command me to call timely on him.

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: I have almost slipp’d the hour.

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: I’ll bring you to him.

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: I know this is a joyful trouble to you;

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: But yet ’tis one.

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: The labour we delight in physics pain.

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: This is the door.

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: I’ll make so bold to call.

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: For ’tis my limited service.
[_Exit Macduff._]

lines.text: Goes the King hence today?

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: He does. He did appoint so.

lines.speaker: LENNOX
lines.text: The night has been unruly: where we lay,

lines.speaker: LENNOX
lines.text: Our chimneys were blown down and, as they say,

lines.speaker: LENNOX
lines.text: Lamentings heard i’ th’ air, strange screams of death,

lines.speaker: LENNOX
lines.text: And prophesying, with accents terrible,

lines.speaker: LENNOX
lines.text: Of dire combustion and confus’d events,

lines.speaker: LENNOX
lines.text: New hatch’d to the woeful time. The obscure bird

lines.speaker: LENNOX
lines.text: Clamour’d the live-long night. Some say the earth

lines.speaker: LENNOX
lines.text: Was feverous, and did shake.

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: ’Twas a rough night.

lines.speaker: LENNOX
lines.text: My young remembrance cannot parallel

lines.speaker: LENNOX
lines.text: A fellow to it.

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: O horror, horror, horror!

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: Tongue nor heart cannot conceive nor name thee!

lines.speaker: MACBETH, LENNOX
lines.text: What’s the matter?

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: Confusion now hath made his masterpiece!

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: Most sacrilegious murder hath broke ope

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: The Lord’s anointed temple, and stole thence

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: The life o’ th’ building.

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: What is’t you say? the life?

lines.speaker: LENNOX
lines.text: Mean you his majesty?

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: Approach the chamber, and destroy your sight

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: With a new Gorgon. Do not bid me speak.

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: See, and then speak yourselves.

lines.text: Awake, awake!—

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: Ring the alarum bell.—Murder and treason!

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: Banquo and Donalbain! Malcolm! awake!

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: Shake off this downy sleep, death’s counterfeit,

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: And look on death itself! Up, up, and see

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: The great doom’s image. Malcolm! Banquo!

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: As from your graves rise up, and walk like sprites

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: To countenance this horror!
[_Alarum-bell rings._]

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: What’s the business,

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: That such a hideous trumpet calls to parley

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: The sleepers of the house? Speak, speak!

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: O gentle lady,

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: ’Tis not for you to hear what I can speak:

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: The repetition, in a woman’s ear,

lines.text: Would murder as it fell.

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: O Banquo, Banquo!

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: Our royal master’s murder’d!

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Woe, alas!

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: What, in our house?

lines.speaker: BANQUO

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: Dear Duff, I pr’ythee, contradict thyself,

lines.speaker: BANQUO

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Had I but died an hour before this chance,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: I had liv’d a blessed time; for, from this instant

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: There’s nothing serious in mortality.

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: All is but toys: renown and grace is dead;

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: The wine of life is drawn, and the mere lees

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Is left this vault to brag of.

lines.speaker: DONALBAIN
lines.text: What is amiss?

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: You are, and do not know’t:

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: The spring, the head, the fountain of your blood

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Is stopp’d; the very source of it is stopp’d.

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: Your royal father’s murder’d.

lines.speaker: MALCOLM
lines.text: O, by whom?

lines.speaker: LENNOX
lines.text: Those of his chamber, as it seem’d, had done’t:

lines.speaker: LENNOX
lines.text: Their hands and faces were all badg’d with blood;

lines.speaker: LENNOX
lines.text: So were their daggers, which, unwip’d, we found

lines.speaker: LENNOX
lines.text: Upon their pillows. They star’d, and were distracted;

lines.speaker: LENNOX
lines.text: No man’s life was to be trusted with them.

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: O, yet I do repent me of my fury,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: That I did kill them.

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: Wherefore did you so?

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Who can be wise, amaz’d, temperate, and furious,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Loyal and neutral, in a moment? No man:

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Th’ expedition of my violent love

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Outrun the pauser, reason. Here lay Duncan,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: His silver skin lac’d with his golden blood;

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: And his gash’d stabs look’d like a breach in nature

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: For ruin’s wasteful entrance: there, the murderers,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Steep’d in the colours of their trade, their daggers

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Unmannerly breech’d with gore. Who could refrain,

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: That had a heart to love, and in that heart

lines.speaker: MACBETH
lines.text: Courage to make’s love known?

lines.speaker: LADY MACBETH
lines.text: Help me hence, ho!

lines.speaker: MACDUFF
lines.text: Look to the lady.

lines.speaker: MALCOLM
lines.text: Why do we hold our tongues,

lines.speaker: MALCOLM
lines.text: That most may claim this argument for ours?

lines.speaker: DONALBAIN
lines.text: What should be spoken here, where our fate,

lines.speaker: DONALBAIN
lines.text: Hid in an auger hole, may rush, and seize us?

lines.speaker: DONALBAIN
lines.text: Let’s away. Our tears are not yet brew’d.

lines.speaker: MALCOLM
lines.text: Nor our strong sorrow

lines.speaker: MALCOLM

lines.text: Look to the lady:—

lines.text: And when we have our naked frailties hid,

lines.speaker: BANQUO
lines.text: That suffer in exposure, let us meet,

lines.speaker: BANQUO

lines.speaker: BANQUO

lines.text: Let’s briefly put on manly readiness,

lines.text: And meet i’ th’ hall together.

lines.text: What will you do? Let’s not consort with them:

lines.text: Is to avoid the aim. Therefore to horse;

lines.speaker: MALCOLM
lines.text: And let us not be dainty of leave-taking,
